description.text: This program is aiming to cultivate international talents with a systematical and comprehensive knowledge of computer technology including computer hardware, software and application. And the ability to conduct academic research. Graduates are capable of working in scientific research departments, education unit, enterprise, institution, computer hardware/software development and administrative department to engage in computer science teaching, science research and computer science and technology application. Main Courses: Circuit Theory, Analog Electronics Technique, Digital Logic, Numerical Analysis, Principles of Computer, Microcomputer Technique, Computer Systems Organization, Computer Network, High Level Language, Assembly Language, Data Structure, Operating System, etc.

duration.text: The Computer Science and Technology at Chongqing Technology and Business University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2638 USD/per year ￥ 19000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3 or above 5. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record.

requirements.text: Applicants must be in possession of a senior high school diploma and a level-6 certificate in HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test), and be from 18 to 45 years old. The applicant must also be physically sound.
